nodes.name: ⏰ Daily Trigger (9am Weekdays)
nodes.notes: Runs every weekday at 9am. Change time in cron expression if needed.

nodes.name: 📋 Fetch Leads from Notion CRM
nodes.notes: Pulls leads with status = 'To Contact' from your Notion CRM. Limit 20 per day to stay safe for cold outreach.

nodes.name: 🔀 Route by Channel
nodes.notes: Routes leads to LinkedIn or Email flow based on Channel field in Notion.

nodes.name: ✍️ Build LinkedIn Connection Message
nodes.notes: Personalises the connection request message based on lead segment. Edit the message templates here.

nodes.name: ✍️ Build Cold Email
nodes.notes: Builds personalised cold emails per segment. Edit sender name and email templates in the code.

nodes.name: 📧 Send Cold Email
nodes.notes: Sends the cold email via Gmail. Connect your hello@getignaite.com Gmail account here. For ImprovMX forwarding setup, use SMTP node instead.

nodes.name: 📝 Prepare CRM Log Entry
nodes.notes: Prepares the data to update the lead record in Notion after outreach is sent.

nodes.name: ✅ Update Notion — LinkedIn Lead
nodes.notes: Updates the lead status in Notion CRM after LinkedIn message is prepared.

nodes.name: ✅ Update Notion — Email Lead
nodes.notes: Updates the lead status in Notion CRM after cold email is sent.

nodes.name: ⏰ Follow-Up Trigger (10am Weekdays)
nodes.notes: Runs every weekday at 10am to check for leads that need a follow-up today.

nodes.name: 📋 Fetch Leads Due for Follow-Up
nodes.notes: Finds leads with status 'Contacted' where Follow Up Date = today.

nodes.name: ✍️ Build Follow-Up Message
nodes.notes: Determines which follow-up step to send (Follow-Up 1 or Follow-Up 2) and builds the message. After 2 follow-ups, marks lead as 'No Response'.

nodes.name: 🔀 Should Send Follow-Up?
nodes.notes: Checks if we should still send a follow-up or if the sequence is complete.

nodes.name: 📧 Send Follow-Up Email
nodes.notes: Sends the follow-up email via Gmail.

nodes.name: ✅ Update Notion After Follow-Up
nodes.notes: Updates the Notion CRM with the new step and next follow-up date.

nodes.name: 🔒 Mark Sequence Complete
nodes.notes: Marks the lead as 'No Response' after 2 follow-ups with no reply. Can be re-activated later manually.

nodes.name: ⏰ Weekly Summary Trigger (Friday 6pm)
nodes.notes: Runs every Friday evening to compile the weekly outreach summary.

nodes.name: 📊 Fetch This Week's Outreach
nodes.notes: Fetches all leads contacted this week for the summary report.

nodes.name: 📊 Build Weekly Summary
nodes.notes: Compiles stats from the week into a clean summary report.

nodes.name: 📧 Email Weekly Summary to Yourself
nodes.notes: Sends you the weekly outreach summary every Friday. Change 'your-personal@gmail.com' to your actual email.
